sloka: देव असुर गणान् वा अपि स गन्धर्व उरगान् भुवि ।यैः अमित्रान् प्रसह्य आजौ वशीकृत्य जयिष्यसि ॥१-२७-३॥
transliteration: deva asura gaṇān vā api sa gandharva uragān bhuvi ।yaiḥ amitrān prasahya ājau vaśīkṛtya jayiṣyasi ॥1-27-3॥

translations.english: With the help of these celestial weapons, you will vanquish even gods and demons, serpents together with gandharvas if they challenge you to a battle as enemies and take them as captives. I shall confer on you all such weapons. May you prosper
